method.profile: One release executable; serial then pipelined, each 200 warmup + 300 measured frames at 1280x720. Native installed-content fixture; classic and particle presentation SafeRandom seeds 587. Byte comparison and hashing occur outside timed intervals. One raster worker plus app simulation on two distinct physical cores.
method.stage_bound: Scene preparation is serial. Bound is prepare + max(simulation, graphics execution); these rendering-heavy scenarios also meet max(simulation, preparation + graphics execution) within measured noise.
method.physical_present: CPU profile uses production retained rasterization and physical scaling; it does not include a native window present. The separate fleet probe exercises real GPU submission/presentation.
method.baseline: Serial execution in the final profile executable; production fleet baseline is the unchanged synchronous binary built at the structural commit.
method.fleet: Headless host and one GUI client with 12 local player profiles on the same two cores; HarpoonRace seed 1, 800x600, paired no-op release controls every 200ms. Raw probes measure submission through synchronized execution.
method.allocations: Not instrumented. The worker retains one owned scene; audio feedback excludes terrain. CPU mode reuses one additional physical RGBA buffer.
limitations: One machine and fixed run order; not a low-end hardware guarantee or a statistical latency non-inferiority claim.
The complete fleet gate reports failures which are retained verbatim; do not equate completed input samples with a passing fleet gate.
All rendered clients share one CPU and GPU; this measures local fleet contention, not independent client hardware.
Startup-to-PlayerInfo-admission timing includes process, asset, and profile startup and is not network RTT.

acceptance.preferred_message_route_topology: host route required in central/async mode; exact peer coverage required in decentral mode
